feedback: Written before this candidate races, so no outcome is claimed for it. The evidence is iteration 5, the best raced design (score 306.5). It finished 10 of 20 oval trials at a mean time of 1.83 s, and mean rms_error was about 0.02. Every s-bend and slalom trial ended off track, with max_error at 0.062 to 0.064 m against the 0.06 m limit, and progress of 0.39 and 0.28. Iteration 4 showed that kp 3.7 hurt the harder tracks, so keeping kp at 3.0 is supported. The candidate changes only sensor y (0.03 to 0.05 m) against the iteration 5 baseline. Its geometry is inside the contract limits (y allowed up to 0.08), and the sensor spacing and footprints are unchanged, so the race can isolate the turn-in lag hypothesis. The change is valid and single-variable, and it is a sensible test of the remaining failure at the sharp bends. Approve so the race gives per-step evidence on the sensor-position effect. After the race, read the results in this order. (a) If max_error on the s-bend and slalom still reaches 0.06 while steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, the forward sensors are amplifying jitter: lower kd from 0.8 toward 0.6. (b) If max_error on those tracks is still at the limit with steering_oscillation unchanged, steering authority is the limit: raise kp from 3.0 toward 3.3 with kd held. (c) If progress stalls below 0.3 with no off-track exit, base_speed is too low for the 3 s limit: raise it from 1.3 toward 1.4 or 1.5 in 0.1 steps. Ignore line_loss_events as an array signal if they stay near 1 per run and the terminal event is the off-track exit.
requested_changes: If max_error on the s-bend and slalom still reaches 0.06 m with steering_oscillation above 0.35 after the sensor move, lower kd from 0.8 toward 0.6, because the forward sensors may be amplifying jitter (iteration 5 oscillation was 0.26 to 0.32 on the harder tracks).

If max_error on the s-bend and slalom still reaches 0.06 m with steering_oscillation unchanged, raise kp from 3.0 toward 3.3 with kd held at 0.8, because iteration 5 shows the bends fail at max_error 0.062 to 0.064 and iteration 4 showed higher kp only helped with the wider array and not in isolation.

If progress stays below 0.3 on the s-bend or slalom with no off-track exit, raise base_speed from 1.3 toward 1.4 or 1.5 in 0.1 steps with the same gains, because iteration 1 finished the oval at 1.65 s at base_speed 1.4.
